facts.text: Jon is putting in a lot of work on his business despite facing obstacles.

evidence.quote: I'm putting in a lot of work on my business even with the obstacles.

facts.text: Gina acknowledges Jon's drive and expresses confidence in his ability to succeed.

evidence.quote: Wow! You've got drive! Keep it up and you'll definitely make a splash.

evidence.quote: Thanks Gina! Your help really means a lot. Sometimes it's hard when things don't go my way...

facts.text: Gina reassures Jon that setbacks are opportunities for comebacks and offers her full support.

evidence.quote: Setbacks are just opportunities for comebacks. You got the skills, passion, and drive. Plus my full support.
